About

Who is filming.

I am the founder of Operator Uplift, a Solana commitment app where people put down a refundable commitment deposit and submit AI-checked daily proof. It has 7,150+ accounts and is live in the Solana Mobile Seeker dApp Store as a private ecosystem beta.

  • 9,397 followers on X, figures pulled Nov 22, 2026
  • 19 hackathon and event wins
  • 13 years in esports content and competing
  • Door-to-door sales background ($1M+ in sales)

How this would work

Four steps, then the files.

  1. 01

    You pick Spotlight ($250) or Feature ($500), or a small custom brief.

  2. 02

    We agree the filming window (your booth, side event, or both) and any review preference.

  3. 03

    I film during 27–30 Nov 2026 and send drafts, then final files, within 72 hours.

  4. 04

    Payment details can be agreed in writing before I film. Nothing is posted until the draft is approved if you want a review.

If this is useful, reply to matthew.d.sim@gmail.com and I will work around your schedule in Bangkok.
